prose: Teri Hunter, intuitive astrologer, joins InnerVerse to talk about the possibilities we can unleash when we become fully conscious of the power of our free will choices in life. Through meditation and self-work, Teri has opened up her mediumistic abilities, and an intuitive capacity to connect with spiritual guides, to bring forth powerful messages from our unseen protectors & teachers. Teri's life's work involves a variety of tools for greater clarity of self-knowledge, including astrology, tarot, & Reiki. She provides regular updates on the astrological climate through her YouTube channel.
music: InnerVerse intro theme by Conspiracy Music Guru
